verdictA_actualCaseCoverage.claim: Guest post-extension-reload and page-reload behavior is observed for one smaller-image tile and one icon tile on frozen DEV 0.2.584. Both opened the displayed authored resource with canonical referral tagging, then returned to the original captured Images pane.
evidence: Operator receipt records the guest identity, extension reload feedback, page reload, fresh capture (1 smaller image and 8 icons), literal displayed/opened URLs, and return state for both clicks.

Smaller SVG host/path is preserved and referral source/medium are added. Icon PNG host/path is preserved; utm_source is replaced, utm_medium added, and utm_campaign/utm_content remain in order. These changes match the canonical outbound-referral contract.
Prior 0.2.579 evidence covers warm opens in all three tiers and a post-reload large-image open, but it is a different artifact and cannot fill the missing 0.2.584 large-tier substep.
limits: The 0.2.584 capture had zero large images; T41's large, smaller, and icon tiers were not all exercised after reload on this build.
Guest only. Member/admin, Store, and other builds are unverified.
Signed or credential URLs, internal-domain exceptions, encoding edge cases, and copied authored URLs were not exercised. T42 clipboard behavior is outside this result.

verdictB_evidenceAndProvenanceQuality.status: artifact binding strong; UI evidence operator-recorded and bounded
verdictB_evidenceAndProvenanceQuality.claim: The build provenance is coherently bound to source 5a1b9e1, CI run 39649558400/artifact 12369911241, promotion receipt, tree hash 93ac42aa…, loaded DEV path, version 0.2.584, and observed Chrome reload. The UI outcomes are detailed literal observations, not independently replayed UI evidence.
evidence: CI/adoption and promotion receipts agree on exact source, successful full CI run, artifact ID/digest, promoted tree hash, version, extension ID, and output path.

The operator receipt reports the same tree hash rehashed before UI work. Chrome exposed the expected ID, version, path, and literal Reloaded feedback; Chrome itself did not expose the source or artifact digest.

The independent watcher reports 21 valid JSONL records, 15 healthy samples over 242 seconds, zero unsafe/malformed events, and a valid final decision. Local SHA-256 of the completed journal matches the watch report. This validates resource-policy completion only, not the UI sequence or product behavior.
limits: No retained screenshots or independent UI replay were supplied in this evidence set; the literal URL comparisons substantiate the claimed bounded outcome if the operator transcription is accurate, but are not independent corroboration.
Actual holder exit 0 and watcher success establish clean process/resource completion, not full-case acceptance.
